expected_rules: Ctrl-K opens the Commands page (the advertised local-command entry)
The page owns focus: styled heading, search row and the local-command roster
Every cell style resolves through the selected theme
Wide cells keep a continuation column; no cell is silently dropped
Cursor/focus/action traces are compared together with styled cells
purpose: Deterministic Commands page (Ctrl-K) at 120x40, dark theme
